# David Chen

> David Chen (David Zekai Chen, @dzkchen) is a software developer and CS + Finance student at the University of Waterloo in Waterloo, Ontario, Canada. Builds AI tools, fintech products, and developer software.

## Experience

- Member of Technical Staff Intern at Ise AI (Sequoia-backed startup): built marketing automations supporting ad campaigns for brands including KATSEYE.
- Full Stack Software Engineering Intern at GWL: built tools for coordinating multiple clients across B2B freight and drayage.
- Co-building a logistics startup focused on OCR with a Meta software engineer (paused).
- Built payment credit software for a high school processing $14.8K/yr across 5,600+ transactions and 1,000+ users.

## Projects

- [fraserpayv2](https://github.com/dzkchen/fraserpayv2): payment system for a school charity event; reduced fraud and made money trails auditable. $14.8K processed yearly, 5,600+ transactions, 1,000+ users.
- [Doceo](https://github.com/dzkchen/doceo): 2nd place at Eureka Hacks 2026. Piano coach that turns a performance video into score alignment, posture checks, and practice feedback.
- [Penny](https://github.com/dzkchen/penny): 2nd place at JamHacks 10 (GenAI). Semi-autonomous pentesting with sandboxed models and deterministic signals that hands ranked fixes to coding agents.
- [Fraser Grads '26](https://github.com/dzkchen/grad-26): Go project using middleware and storage buckets; 300+ submissions.
- [Dhen](https://github.com/dzkchen/dhen): Minecraft mod built with Fabric and Kotlin (282 commits over two months).
- [Oh My Diff](https://github.com/dzkchen/oh-my-diff)
